draft.weaknessQuote: Long legs cause slower hip flips to run with vertical routes.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.89, the 3rd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 1st of 1 at two-way CB/WR. He went 2nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: DeVonta Smith / Darius Slay. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,258 receiving yards in 2024, 1st of 1 two-way CB/WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Jacksonville Jaguars. 7 career games and 4 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 5 AV in 2025. Weak spots: yards per target 6.6 (19th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 wide receiver who played: 298 receiving yards against a median of 198, above the norm.
